description: Issues #1422 and #1477: the keys an agent's prompt gets from both clients, and the bytes each one sends. One table, every platform: neither client picks rows by platform. Read by the TUI's `keyevent_editing_chords_match_the_shared_table` and `keyevent_application_cursor_rows_match_the_shared_table` (src/ui.rs) and by the desktop's terminalKeys.test.ts, TerminalViewport.keys.test.tsx and e2e/agent-terminal-input.spec.ts, so a row changed on one side fails the other. `translated` is the TUI's `editing_chord_bytes` and the desktop's `editingSequence`: each client checks that it translates exactly these chords and no others. `standard` is what both send with the ordinary terminal encoding (the TUI's `keyevent_to_bytes`, xterm.js on the desktop), measured from xterm.js 6.0.0. `application_cursor` is what both send instead while the program in the pane has turned on application cursor mode (DECCKM, `ESC[?1h`), until it turns it off (`ESC[?1l`); a row of the other two lists that it does not name is sent unchanged in that mode. Modifiers are `ctrl`, `alt`, `shift` and `super` (Cmd on a Mac, the Windows key on Windows); `key` is the DOM KeyboardEvent.key.

translated.action: delete to the start of the line

standard.action: Shift+Delete, whatever the agent binds it to
Ctrl+Home, whatever the agent binds it to

Shift+End, whatever the agent binds it to
